children: announced on Wednesday that their RNA-targeting therapy sefaxersen succeeded in a late-stage trial for patients with primary IgA nephropathy, a kidney disorder.

Citing interim data, the companies said that the once-monthly injectable reached the primary endpoint in their Phase 3 IMAgINATION study, indicating a statistically significant and clinically meaningful reduction in proteinuria.

The 459-patient placebo-controlled study was designed to measure the primary endpoint of proteinuria reduction over 37 weeks using the 24-hour urine protein-to-creatinine ratio, a main indicator of kidney damage.
The antisense oligonucleotide was found to have a favorable safety and tolerability profile with no new safety events, the companies said.
The IMAgINATION study is ongoing to measure changes in kidney function over two years based on the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) at week 105. Roche
